ComplexityText: Enhancing weapon attacks instead of offensive stats as your primary means of damage dealing introduces a little additional consideration. Nonetheless, this class is a novel approach to a fighter, a standard and accessible RPG class.
Description: The Valorous’ Brand for the duelists, fighters, and brawlers. One-on-one combat experts, they augment their Weapon Strikes with additional damage and effects. Battleheart, a unique point system, can be expended for additional melee combat damage and survivability.

Definitions.Name: Battleheart
Text: When dealing damage or taking damage from basic weapon strikes, add half of damage taken as Battleheart
When you would receive damage, first reduce Battleheart. One point of Battleheart reduces incoming damage by a point.
Pay 4 Battleheart or 2 Energy for one of the following effects (select another by paying twice the ability's cost):
Make a free basic weapon attack on an enemy who attacked you within your melee reach
Extend your melee reach to double its normal value until the end of your next turn
Reposition up to 12 feet with a nimble leap (this can be in addition to your movement range, or outside your turn)

Talents.Name: Twinstrike
Talents.SimplifiedDescription: Make a simultaneous weapon attack with all equipped weapons
Text: Make a simultaneous weapon attack with all equipped weapons
Pay energy cost for all, but add together their damage and deal it as a total.
If the enemy dodges your attack, they only dodge the least damaging move and cannot dodge again

Talents.Name: Opportunistic
Text: Trigger: when enemy moves within your melee reach
Immediately launch a Weapon Attack against them

Talents.Name: Shifting Blow
Text: A weapon attack gains Dynamic Strike. If the attack connects, you can change your equipped weapon at no cost

Talents.Name: Violent Dance
Text: When receiving knockback from a melee attack, you can halve damage received and you are redirected inward toward the attack's source
